mood: A signal being forged: a cold cyan oscilloscope trace hammered white-hot on an anvil, in a soot-black foundry wired with copper.

shape.radius: none: chamfered plates (8 px corner cuts on controls, 14 px on panels), hex nuts for cost and energy
shape.borderStyle: 1px oxidised-copper rule; amber top bar on panels; cyan for anything on the beat
shape.texture: charred steel with rivets, a phosphor oscilloscope graticule, faint scanlines, copper PCB traces with solder pads

motifs: the four waveforms as shape-coded glyphs (square pulse, sine, sawtooth, noise)
cold cyan signal turning to molten amber across an anvil
circuit-board act map with chips for nodes
buttonStyle: Primary is a molten-amber chamfered plate with near-black Audiowide text; secondary is charred steel with a copper hairline; on-beat actions (Vent, the tutorial) are arc-cyan.
backdrop: Per act: soot-black foundry, blued coil halls or the white-hot heart; a far oscilloscope trace on a graticule, factory silhouettes, the forge's glow from below, copper traces across the floor plate, slow embers that stop under Globe motion: Still.
motion: Responses to input only, all under 450 ms: damage numbers rise, a hit machine jolts, a destroyed one sinks and cools, a Forge Burst sends one amber ring across the line. The timed mode's beat sweep is the rhythm itself (Steady mode has none). Nothing flashes; ambient embers stop for reduced motion.
